title: Sky Watch
role: Anyone curious about what is up in the sky and under the ground right now
saves: Opening five sites to see where the space station is, when the next rocket flies, where the ground shook and what the weather is
summary: Type =sky-watch: the ISS position, the next launches and the last day's M4.5+ earthquakes, no key. Type a city for its weather and sunrise and sunset. Copy it to join several free sources in one app.
